name: evaluate_formula
description: Evaluate a formula against the active sheet WITHOUT changing any cell, e.g. "=SUM(B2:B10)/COUNT(B2:B10)" or "=VLOOKUP(\"x\",A:B,2,FALSE)". `cell` sets the formula's position for relative references and ROW()/COLUMN().

cell.description: Evaluate as if in this cell (default: active cell)

formula.description: Formula text, with or without the leading =
